# GHC 9.14.1 release-generated header

`include/HsBaseConfig.h.in` is retained byte-for-byte from the official
[GHC 9.14.1 source release](https://downloads.haskell.org/~ghc/9.14.1/ghc-9.14.1-src.tar.xz),
at `ghc-9.14.1/libraries/ghc-internal/include/HsBaseConfig.h.in`.
The release produces this header before packaging; it is absent from the GHC
Git repository. All other Windows source-inventory files come from the GHC
submodule.

- Release archive SHA-256: `2a83779c9af86554a3289f2787a38d6aa83d00d136aa9f920361dd693c101e77`
- Header SHA-256: `45ab1cf2ee1b8c226941e0c084cf01f44f9f418a65483b336e847aae6459f4da`
- License: GHC's BSD-3-Clause terms, retained in the
  [upstream package license](../ghc-9.14.1/libraries/ghc-internal/LICENSE).

THC does not regenerate or modify this file.
